Package gui

Class TableManagementController

java.lang.Object
gui.TableManagementController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class TableManagementController extends Object implements Initializable
Controller for the Table Management view. This class allows restaurant staff to view all tables in the restaurant, monitor their status (Available, Occupied), and modify table properties like seat capacity or location. It also handles adding and deleting tables.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL location, ResourceBundle resources)
      Initializes the controller class. This method is automatically called after the fxml file has been loaded. It sets up the table columns, action buttons, and input controls for new tables.
      Specified by:
      initialize in interface Initializable
      Parameters:
      location - The location used to resolve relative paths for the root object.
      resources - The resources used to localize the root object.

    • setupActionsColumn

      private void setupActionsColumn()
      Configures the actions column by creating a custom cell factory. Each row will contain "Update Seats" and "Delete" buttons with their respective event handlers.

    • refreshTableData

      void refreshTableData(ActionEvent event)
      Refreshes the table data displayed in the view by fetching the latest information from the server.
      Parameters:
      event - The action event triggered by the refresh button.

    • fetchTables

      void fetchTables()
      Sends a request to the server to retrieve all current tables.

    • handleAddTable

      void handleAddTable(ActionEvent event)
      Handles the "Add Table" request. Validates UI input and sends the new table details to the server.

    • updateTableList

      public void updateTableList(ArrayList<data.Table> tables)
      Updates the TableView with a new list of tables received from the server. Ensures the update occurs on the JavaFX Application Thread.
      Parameters:
      tables - The updated list of Table objects.

    • handleOperationResponse

      public void handleOperationResponse(Object response)
      Processes responses from the server regarding table operations. Handles success notifications, occupancy warnings, and reservation conflicts.
      Parameters:
      response - The response object received from the server.
